clips.title: The story
paras: Rorian the Dayseeker is an elder Skyborne figure situated in Thendal Village on Zephras Isle. He oversees the initiation of young fledglings as they discover their calling, step into maturity, and attune themselves to the natural elements of their homeland. Under his watchful guidance, newcomers learn the fundamentals of survival, tradition, and service to their community.

Within the serene confines of Thendal Village on Zephras Isle, Rorian the Dayseeker stands as one of the primary mentors for the fledgling Skyborne. Revered for his experience and calm wisdom, Rorian directs youth during their crucial transition into adulthood. It is under his instruction that initiates undertake their traditional rite of passage, marking their readiness to defend and support their island home.

Beyond fundamental trials, Rorian points promising initiates toward specialized paths suited to their talents. Whether an aspiring warrior, hunter, rogue, mage, shaman, or druid, fledglings are directed by Rorian to dedicated trainers across the isle. He also alerts them to elemental disturbances disrupting the island's harmony, instilling an enduring duty to preserve balance across the windswept heights.
